name: Wind Stance
benefit:
If you move more than 5 feet this turn, you gain 20% concealment for 1 round against ranged attacks.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 135
When using this feat, you can spend 5 stamina points to gain 20% concealment for 1 round against all attacks (not just ranged attacks).
flavor: Your erratic movements make it difficult for enemies to pinpoint your location.
